content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-one-afternoon-fast-track-3|Selling Digital]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-music-online-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/accepting-bitcoin-ebook-sales-everything-you-need-get-17|COREMERCH guide to accepting]]-bitcoin-guide-7|everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-13. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

The ability to sell digital products online without platform fees is a game-changer for creators. Gumroad, for instance, charges 10% on every sale, which can add up quickly. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, retaining more earnings for the creator. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, a significant amount for any digital business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind selling beats online with crypto payments involves several key components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. By leveraging free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack without relying on conventional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. It's designed for those who want to maintain full ownership and control over their digital products and sales process, without being locked into platform fees or restrictions. By using crypto payments, creators can reach a global audience and receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks eliminate platform fees and restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this architecture work together seamlessly include NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These tools integrate to provide a smooth and efficient sales process, from payment processing to product delivery. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to build and deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stack.

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the necessary components, such as hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. They can then integrate these components using the provided blueprints and templates, and configure their store to accept crypto payments. With the right architecture in place, creators can start selling their digital products online and reaching a global audience without platform restrictions or fees.
